program='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h = len(grid)
    w = len(grid[0])
    for c, value in enumerate(grid[-1]):
        if value != 5:
            continue
        anchors = [(r, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] != 0]
        for r in range(h):
            nearest_r, nearest_color = min(anchors, key=lambda item: (abs(item[0] - r), -item[0]))
            out[r][c] = nearest_color
    return out
'''
